decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting birth dates for the same entity, Roland Almon Ritchie. Document 1 (D1S1) states he was born on June 19, 1910, while Document 2 (D2S1) states he was born on January 1, 1900. Both documents describe him as a Canadian lawyer and puisne justice of the Supreme Court of Canada with the same death date (June 5, 1988). Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and treat audit labels/saved answers as fallible, both distinct dates found in the source text are included as valid answers representing the conflicting assertions in the data.
